description: ALWAYS call this first when given a board URL or ID. Resolves the canonical board id and auto-creates the board row if it does not exist yet. Returns a summary (item counts, authors). After this, call BOTH `get_preview` and `get_board` before editing so you can see the layout visually AND know the exact ids/coordinates — do not skip `get_preview`, otherwise you will place new items blindly on top of existing ones.

access_key.description: 8-character lowercase alphanumeric board access key when the board is locked (legacy 6-character lowercase alphanumeric keys are also accepted). Equivalent to setting the `X-Board-Key` HTTP header on the JSON-RPC POST. Omit for unlocked boards. Obtain via POST /api/boards/<id>/lock.

url_or_id.description: Full board URL (https://cnvs.app/#<id>) or bare UUID.

name: open_board
title: Open Board
